Name: Stardew Audio Captions
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=3][size=4]About Stardew Audio Captions[/size]

Many aspects of Stardew Valley rely on sound cues to convey information, making this information less accessible or inaccessible for many users. This mod aims to caption as much of the game audio as is feasible, including high-priority sounds like monsters spawning off-screen and ambient sounds like birds chirping. It's intended for anyone who may benefit from captioned audio.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

This mod is designed to be highly-configurable so that users can personalize the captions display to best suit their needs. Please install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change the configuration settings. Settings include changing the size and location of the caption display, changing the colors of certain captions, toggling individual captions on and off, and more. Not sure where to find a caption to enable or disable it? Check out the [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/StardewAudioCaptions/docs/caption-list.md]list of all captions[/url]. You can search for the text of the caption to figure out what category it's under.

On the "Files" tab of this page, I have also included optional downloads for suggested configurations of this mod. You should extract the included config.json and place it inside the StardewAudioCaptions folder in your mods folder (where mod config files usually go). You are not required to download one of these config files! SMAPI will automatically create a config.json file for you if one doesn't exist when you launch the game. By default, all captions are enabled and use white text.

[size=4]Multiplayer[/size]

This mod should be functional in multiplayer, although it was only tested in split-screen local co-op. There are some known issues in split-screen co-op due to how the game decides which sound to play and how long to play it for. Because not all sounds are synced, I've chosen to share caption state between screens, so each screen will get the same caption feed. However, it means the duration of captions for some longer sounds may be shortened. Please let me know if you are playing multiplayer or not when reporting potential bugs!

[size=4]Permissions[/size]

This mod is licensed under the [url=https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html]GNU General Public License[/url]. If you have contributions, please do submit a PR at the GitHub link below!

For translators: This licensing means that you are free to upload translation files for this mod. No need to ask!

[size=4]Source Code[/size]

This mod's source can be accessed on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/StardewAudioCaptions]GitHub[/url].

[size=4]Other Mod Recommendations[/size]

If you're interested in other accessibility or ease of play mods, check out the Modding Wiki's [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Recommendations:_Accessibility_and_Ease_of_Play]Accessibility Mod Recommendations List[/url]. (Note: this list may not be fully up to date and some mods may be no longer compatible).
[/size]
